title: Learning About Scripts
description: Discover scripts and learn how they work

story: Bernard: "Hello! Shush, don't say a word."
"I know why you're here. You want a shed!"
"I have just the thing for you. I have the best-shed-maker-in-the-world.sh"
He seems pretty enthusiastic about it. Examine the tool best-shed-maker-in-the-world.sh
Use TAB to speed up your typing.
hints: Use 'cat best-shed-maker-in-the-world.sh' to examine the tool.

story: The tool has an inscription that reads "mkdir shed".
You recognise the command 'mkdir'. It's what you used to help Ruth in the farm.
Bernard: "This tool is called a script. It's incredible. Just run the command, and you get a new shed."
"Try it out. Use it with ./best-shed-maker-in-the-world.sh"
Use TAB to speed up your typing.
hints: Do as Bernard says - use './best-shed-maker-in-the-world.sh' to run his script

story: Look around to see if it created a shed.
It worked! You can see a new shed in the room.
What happens if you run it again?
Press UP twice to replay the command.
hints: See what happens when you run the script again.
Run the script again using './best-shed-maker-in-the-world.sh' to see what happens.

story: You get the error 'mkdir: cannot create directory 'shed': File exists'
Bernard: "Of course it won't work a second time - you already have a shed!"
"I'm working on the next big thing, best-horn-in-the-world.sh."
"It can be used to alert anyone that you're coming. I'm having some teething problems, but I'm sure I'll fix them soon."
Examine best-horn-in-the-world.sh and see if you can identify the problem.
Remember to use TAB!
hints: Use 'cat best-horn-in-the-world.sh' to examine the tool.

story: The script reads 'eco "Honk!"'
Maybe it should read 'echo "Honk!"' instead...
How could we make changes to this script?
Bernard: "Ho ho, you look like you understand the problem."
Eleanor: "If we need extra help, we can go to the library, it was just outside."
Before we go, have a look in the basement.
Bernard: "Oooh naughty, you can't look in there."
Let's leave the shed shop and go back to east of town.
